evals.prompt: I want to build a design sandbox so I can prototype UI using our real design system without touching the production app. Our design system is Untitled UI React, vendored locally as the `@repo/ui` package at {{MONOREPO_DIR}}/packages/ui. Our production app is at {{MONOREPO_DIR}}/apps/main-app -- please recreate the Customers screen (apps/main-app/src/app/customers-page.tsx) as the first real screen in the sandbox. Set the whole sandbox up in this folder: {{TARGET_DIR}}. Treat the production app and design system source as READ-ONLY reference -- do not create, edit, or delete anything outside {{TARGET_DIR}}.
evals.expected_output: A sandbox app scaffolded inside {{TARGET_DIR}} using real @repo/ui components (installed or copied, not reinvented). A COMPONENTS.md index table (Component/Import/Use for/Wrong move -> right move) covering the design system's most-used components. A CLAUDE.md rules file with the 'check COMPONENTS.md and real source, else stop and ask' rule with real, filled-in file paths. A recreated Customers screen using fake data, with no data-fetching/auth/permission code copied over. Nothing written outside {{TARGET_DIR}}.

assertions.text: A sandbox app exists at outputs/sandbox with a package.json
COMPONENTS.md exists at the sandbox root
COMPONENTS.md contains the 4-column table (Component / Import / Use for / Wrong move -> right move)
CLAUDE.md exists at the sandbox root
CLAUDE.md has no leftover bracket placeholders like [design system] or [path]
The recreated screen references real Customer data/columns (name/domain/status)
The recreated screen imports from the real design system rather than reinventing components
Nothing was written/modified outside the sandbox folder (production repo untouched)
No real data-fetching/auth code was copied into the recreated screen

evals.prompt: Set up a design sandbox using shadcn/ui (https://ui.shadcn.com) in this folder: {{TARGET_DIR}}. We don't have an existing app to pull a screen from yet -- as the first real screen, build a simple Account Settings screen with a form (name field, email field) and a Save button, using real shadcn/ui components.
evals.expected_output: A fresh Vite (or similarly minimal) React app scaffolded in {{TARGET_DIR}} with shadcn/ui installed via its CLI and verified with a default-styled component. A COMPONENTS.md index for shadcn/ui's components. A CLAUDE.md rules file with real paths filled in. An Account Settings screen built from the description (no source app existed) using real shadcn/ui form/input/button components, not hand-rolled lookalikes, with fake/no backend logic.

assertions.text: A sandbox app exists at outputs/sandbox with a package.json
shadcn/ui is actually installed (components.json config present)
COMPONENTS.md exists at the sandbox root
CLAUDE.md exists at the sandbox root
CLAUDE.md has no leftover bracket placeholders
An Account Settings screen exists with name/email fields and a Save action
The screen imports real shadcn/ui components rather than hand-rolled lookalikes
